MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CASE
    WHEN o.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS ',' THEN 2026 - CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, ',', 2)) AS INT64)
    WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN 2026 - CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
    WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '-' THEN 2026 - CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '-', 1) AS INT64)
    WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS ' ' THEN 2026 - CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, ' ', 2) AS INT64)
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(o.birth_date AS INT64)
  END AS age
WHERE age < 65 OR o.nationality <> 'Israeli-American'
RETURN age AS col1, o.name AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
